description: This file defines the TaskQueue class in the GuzzleHttpomise namespace, implementing a FIFO task queue for executing tasks asynchronously within Guzzle promises handling. It manages task scheduling, shutdown behavior, and provides methods to add tasks and run them.

classes.name: TaskQueue
classes.description: A task queue that executes tasks in a FIFO order, used internally in GuzzleHttp promises to manage execution of asynchronous tasks while maintaining a constant stack size.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the task queue, optionally registering a shutdown function to run remaining tasks when the script exits.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns true if the task queue is empty, false otherwise.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a callable task to the queue.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes all tasks in the queue in order until empty.

methods.name: disableShutdown
methods.description: Disables the automatic shutdown processing of the task queue when the script exits.
